title: Life Cycle Evidence Planning
description: This course will cover the design and development of an integrated evidence plan (IEP) from early and late-stage clinical development (including phase I, II, and III) to post approval including real world data (RWD), phase 3b/4, investigator initiated and label enhancement studies. Prerequisites: CLRE 250 or CLRE 250R or CLRE 236 or CLRE 236R and admission to the MAS Clinical Research Program or consent of department.
